summary: iter92 RE-VERIFY (post Expo/Metro restart): the Step 6-7 'AI Assess All' bulk action NOW correctly calls the chunked BATCH endpoint, NOT the per-cell endpoint. Stale-bundle regression from iter92(prev) is GONE. Seeded a fresh decision with 4 factors x 3 options = 12 empty cells (2 factors with no expected_value to force the 3-button 'AI-fill all' dialog). Opened /prr/{id}?step=7, captured ALL /api/* network calls during the bulk action, tapped testID='ai-assess-all' and chose 'AI-fill all'. RESULT: exactly 2 POST calls to /api/decisions/{id}/ai-assess-batch (12 cells / CHUNK=6 = 2 batches), ZERO per-cell POST calls to /factors/{fid}/ai-assess, no 405s, completion banner appeared ('AI Assess All complete'). Regression check also PASSED: tapping the single-cell sparkle ✨AI button (testID='md-ai-{optionId}-{factorId}') still fires exactly ONE POST to /api/decisions/{id}/factors/{fid}/ai-assess (200 OK), no batch call — and the cell populated with 100% (Salary expected >= 100000, actual 120000). The implementation in Step7.tsx:442-488 (runBulkAssess with CHUNK=6 and api.post('/decisions/{id}/ai-assess-batch', ...)) is now actually served to the browser.

minor.issue: Secondary observation (not the network/routing fix under review): the batch endpoint itself returned 200 OK in 1624ms, but every cell inside the batch failed because the LiteLLM budget cap was reached: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.42548, Max budget: 0.4' (backend.err.log 15:47:11). Hence 'Assessed 0 cells • 12 failed'. The single-cell run after that ALSO went through (with the same fallback path) and produced 100% for Salary because that one cell happened to take the gemini emergent fallback path before the budget tripped again. This is a budget/quota concern unrelated to the routing fix.
